name: Mount Syliph
title: Mount Syliph
summary: One of the mountains of the Mount Alphus range; a portal to the Syliph Tower dungeon is on it (acpedia). In the kit it is a flat-topped rock pillar: a ~90 x 100 m summit plateau at z 224 with sheer flanks falling to the plain at z 110; the South Dalt portal stands on the north rim and the Syliph Tower portal on the south-west. Landblocks to the west and south (0x8C8D-0x8C90, 0x8D8D, 0x8E8D, 0x8F8D) are missing; the shot hovers over the summit.

site.name: Mount Syliph
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer north-syliph (the summit plateau, 8 m from the South Dalt portal on the north rim). [critic b4-7 2026-10-15: teleport changed from '@teleloc 0x8E8F000B 42.1 65.5 224 -0.446198 0 0 -0.894934' because the gazetteer drop was 5.1 m from the South Dalt portal (weenieType Portal). Derived drop 8.5 m south-west on flat summit ground (224.0, level within 1 m for 12 m around), 13.3 m from the portal, 11.6 m from any drawn object. Cell index = floor(lx/24)*8+floor(ly/24)+1, z = ground + 0.5.]

shots.standingOrder: Hover 22 m above the flat summit of Mount Syliph and turn 120 degrees from the pillars of Dalt and Gemm in the north-east round to the plains in the south-east; nothing within 50 m, golems may be faded.
